prompt: Harden save-game serialization: detect truncated writes and reject bad blobs before they reach `simStateSerialization`.
Add a narrow validation step on load of persisted empire state so unknown fields never overwrite core simulation invariants.
Improve `/test-env/save-load-api-guard`: tighten the TypeScript types that describe the wire-format payload for save slots.
Refactor the save-export path to return a typed result object instead of silent failures when schema checks fail.
When autosave runs mid-turn, ensure the serialized snapshot includes a monotonic save revision field for debugging.
Guard against JSON parse errors on the server route that accepts client-offered save payloads; fail closed with a clear error code.
Add compatibility shims for older save versions: map legacy keys into the current `game` types without widening unsafe casts.
Tighten API handler validation for `/api` routes that return saved match summaries so response bodies match declared OpenAPI-ish shapes.
Instrument save/load with defensive checks so corrupted gzip layers never crash the worker thread.
Reduce blast radius: if deserialization yields NaN or Infinity for economy counters, clamp or reject the save as invalid.
Ensure multiplayer bridge code refuses to apply remote state blobs that fail the same server-side schema used for local saves.
Add a lightweight checksum or hash step after serialization of game state so bit rot is caught before writing to disk.
Clarify error messages for save failures (disk full vs schema mismatch) while keeping Fallen Empire tone in user-visible strings.
Split read vs write paths in `simStateSerialization` so read-only preview tools cannot accidentally persist partial state.
Add request size limits and early rejection for oversized save uploads hitting the preview workflow API.
After load, run a single canonical normalize pass that fills optional fields with safe defaults instead of scattering `??` fixes.
Tighten auth on internal dev-only save import routes: require an explicit test header and no-op in production builds.
Make serialization errors observable: log structured reasons without leaking full save contents to the client.
Fix edge case where empty string save id collides with quick-save slot naming; enforce non-empty identifiers at the API boundary.
Align `gameCore` hydration with `game` types when reading saved game bytes: remove unsafe assertions when reconstructing fleets and provinces from disk.
Add round-trip stress coverage ideas in comments and a tiny helper that asserts serialization is stable for the golden fixtures.
When exporting save previews over the API, strip secrets (tokens if any) from diagnostic attachments while preserving simulation fields.
Improve caching headers for immutable save-derived assets so browsers do not stale-cache broken exports after failed writes.
Finalize a production-minded pass on the start/load flow hooks: prioritize schema validation and deterministic ordering of side effects.
Performance review focused on serialization hot paths—avoid quadratic merges when layering incremental patches onto base saves.
Plan a phased rollout for stricter saves: backward compatible reads, strict writes, documented breaking change version bump.
Evaluate current vs proposed Zod (or similar) validator coverage for persisted save state and outline minimal additions only.
